definitions.explanation: Polite prefix added to nouns to show respect, often relating to the listener or a third party.

examples.japanese: ご{協力|きょうりょく}に{感謝|かんしゃ}します。
ご{質問|しつもん}は{ありません→ある：00006_aru}か。
ご{家族|かぞく}によろしくお{伝|つた}えください。
examples.english: Please give my regards to your family.

notes:
ご is an honorific prefix used to show respect.

USAGE RULES:
- ご attaches to words of Chinese origin ({漢語|かんご})
- お attaches to words of Japanese origin ({和語|わご})
- Some words accept both (ご{返事|へんじ}/お{返事|へんじ})

COMMON WORDS WITH ご:
- ご{協力|きょうりょく}: (your) cooperation
- ご{質問|しつもん}: (your) question
- ご{家族|かぞく}: (your) family
- ご{連絡|れんらく}: (your) contact/message
- ご{注文|ちゅうもん}: (your) order
- ご{意見|いけん}: (your) opinion
- ご{案内|あんない}: guidance
- ご{説明|せつめい}: explanation

FIXED EXPRESSIONS:
- ご{覧|らん}ください: please look
- ご{存知|ぞんじ}: (you) know
- ご{馳走|ちそう}さま: thanks for the meal

RELATED:
- お: honorific prefix (for {和語|わご})
